--- title: "06 — Trophic-mode panel: presence/absence across the dataset" author: "Hu Lab" date: last-modified format: html: toc: true toc-depth: 2 code-fold: show df-print: paged --- # Questions * **A. The panel.** How many features and subcategories does each trophic mode hold? * **B. Feature × sample unit.** In which units is each panel feature detected, and how does that track each unit's sequencing depth? * **C. Feature × habitat.** What is the habitat class of each panel feature (vent only, shared, non-vent only, ...)? * **D. Taxon × feature × habitat.** Which class-level (L4) taxa carry each panel feature, at vents, at non-vents, or at both, and how widespread is each across all samples? Every panel gene is scored against every L4 taxon, absences included. * **E. Experimental phagotrophy genes.** Which KOs whose loss impairs phagotrophy *in a protist* are detected, and among which lineages? * **F. Lineage KO pools.** How many KOs does each lineage group (symbiotic or parasitic vs. free-living relatives) contribute? Reported as pool sizes only: the pools are too small to support a gene-set contrast (the rarefied focal − reference contrast was removed on 2026-11-10). **Rules** (`config/params.yml`, shared with 05, 05b and 07): * *Detected* in a unit: ≥ 1 scaledTPM and ≥ 10 per million of the unit's retained expression (`unit_expression()`). The unit total always comes from the full paired table, so panel features use the same denominator as every KO in 05. * *Present in a habitat*: detected in ≥ 3 of that habitat's units (`vent_min_units`, `nonvent_min_units`: ≥ 3 of 13 vent, ≥ 3 of 6 non-vent), the 05 rule (2026-11-23). One count rule for features (C), taxon × feature pairs (D), and the pairs behind E and F. The all-samples P/A panel keeps ≥ 30% of the 19 units (≥ 6) as a "widespread across the dataset" bar. The old 30% habitat rule (≥ 4 of 13, ≥ 2 of 6) and fixed counts (≥ 1 and ≥ 2 units per habitat) are reported as sensitivity. * *Panel features*: a gene is matched by its KEGG KO; a gene with no KO is matched by Pfam domain, and a transcript counts only when all of its Pfam domains belong to that gene (`feature_id` = `pfam:`). Panel rows are compiled by `scripts/00_build_gene_sets.R`. * These are compositional data and the panel is question-driven, so nothing in A–D is tested. Presence means a feature's share of a unit clears detection, not a count of cells, and absence can mean low expression as well as missing genes (no matched metagenome). # Set up ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "scripts/_setup.R") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} FIELDS_IN_SCOPE <- c("Gorda Ridge", "Von Damm", "Piccard") CHOSEN_DEPTH <- 4 MIN_TPM <- params$detect_min_tpm MIN_PER_MILLION <- params$detect_min_per_million OCC_MIN <- params$occupancy_min_frac # all-samples P/A panel (>= 30% of 19 = 6) and the old-rule sensitivity # habitat calls follow 05 (2026-11-23): unit counts; C also uses plume-tolerant vent-only MIN_UNITS <- c(vent = params$vent_min_units, nonvent = params$nonvent_min_units) # 3, 3 VENTONLY_TOLERATED <- params$ventonly_tolerated_tokens # "Plume" SENS_MIN_UNITS <- c(1, 2) # fixed per-habitat unit counts (sensitivity) # the four trophic modes; the same labels as CATEGORY_MAP in scripts/00_build_gene_sets.R TROPHIC_MODES <- c("Heterotrophy/phagotrophy", "Osmotrophy", "Symbiosis", "Parasitism") PANEL_TABLE <- "data/gene-lists/gene_candidates_central.csv" # scripts/00c_build_central_table.R (>SKH: 2026-11-12) SETS_TABLE <- "data/gene-lists/trophic_gene_sets.csv" # scripts/00_build_gene_sets.R EXPERIMENTAL <- "data/gene-lists/protist_phagotrophy_experimental.csv" HABITAT_TABLE <- "output-tables/05_ko_habitat_class.csv"# from 05 PAIR_TABLE <- "output-tables/05b_taxon_ko_pairs.csv.gz" # from 05b (all lienage-resolved KOs VENT_ASSOCIATED <- c("vent_only", "vent_skewed", "shared") class_levels <- c("vent_only", "vent_skewed", "shared", "nonvent_skewed", "nonvent_only", "below_filter", "not_detected") class_pal <- c(vent_only = "#b74a70", vent_skewed = "#dba3b8", shared = "grey45", nonvent_skewed = "#9cc2c2", nonvent_only = "#346D6E", below_filter = "grey85", not_detected = "white") presence_lab <- c(vent_only = "Vent only", nonvent_only = "Non-vent only", both = "Vent and non-vent") presence_pal <- c(vent_only = "#b74a70", nonvent_only = "#346D6E", both = "grey45") ``` ::: # A. The panel One row per feature × subcategory (a feature in two subcategories counts in both), and one row per feature for the feature tables. Every `category` must be one of the four trophic modes. A mode with no rows yet is still listed with zero features, so an empty mode is visible rather than silently missing. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # >SKH: 2026-11-12 central table; unresolved rows (no KO or Pfam yet) stay in the # table but are not matched here panel_ref <- read_csv(PANEL_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |> filter(!is.na(subcategory), status != "unresolved", !is.na(feature_id)) unknown_modes <- setdiff(unique(panel_ref$category), TROPHIC_MODES) if (length(unknown_modes)) { stop("Panel categories outside the four trophic modes: ", paste(unknown_modes, collapse = ", "), ". Add them to CATEGORY_MAP in scripts/00_build_gene_sets.R.", call. = FALSE) } panel_long <- panel_ref |> distinct(feature_id, match_type, category, subcategory, gene) |> mutate(category = factor(category, levels = TROPHIC_MODES)) # >SKH: 2026-11-12 a feature in two modes (shared_flag from 00c) is plotted once, under # heterotrophy/phagotrophy, and marked with a dagger; the tables keep both modes shared_key <- panel_ref |> summarise(shared_modes = first(na.omit(shared_modes)), shared = any(shared_flag %in% TRUE), .by = feature_id) |> mutate(primary_category = if_else(shared, "Heterotrophy/phagotrophy", NA_character_)) panel_plot <- panel_long |> left_join(select(shared_key, feature_id, primary_category), by = "feature_id") |> filter(is.na(primary_category) | category == primary_category) |> select(-primary_category) # >SKH: 2026-11-12 KEGG symbols for KOs whose source label names a whole family ko_symbols <- read_lines("data/external/ko00001.keg") |> str_subset("^D\\s+K\\d{5}") |> str_match("^D\\s+(K\\d{5})\\s+([^;]+)") |> as_tibble(.name_repair = ~ c("line", "feature_id", "symbols")) |> distinct(feature_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |> mutate(ko_symbol = map_chr(str_split(symbols, ",\\s*"), \(s) if (length(s) > 1 && str_detect(s[1], "^E\\d")) s[2] else s[1])) |> select(feature_id, ko_symbol) multi_ko_features <- panel_ref |> filter(match_type == "ko") |> distinct(gene, feature_id) |> filter(n() > 1, .by = gene) |> pull(feature_id) |> unique() # one row per feature; a feature in two subcategories (or modes) lists both panel_features <- panel_long |> summarise(across(c(category, subcategory, gene), \(x) paste(sort(unique(as.character(x))), collapse = " | ")), .by = c(feature_id, match_type)) |> mutate(gene_short = str_remove(gene, " \\(.*$")) |> # >SKH: 2026-11-12 a family label that covers several KOs (e.g. TatC and SecY) gives # every KO the same name, so those KOs also show their KEGG symbol left_join(ko_symbols, by = "feature_id") |> mutate(gene_disp = if_else(feature_id %in% multi_ko_features & !is.na(ko_symbol), paste0(gene_short, ": ", ko_symbol), gene_short), feature_lab = glue("{gene_disp} ({feature_id})")) |> left_join(shared_key, by = "feature_id") |> mutate(primary_category = coalesce(primary_category, category)) panel_summary <- panel_long |> summarise(n_features = n_distinct(feature_id), n_ko = n_distinct(feature_id[match_type == "ko"]), n_pfam = n_distinct(feature_id[match_type == "pfam"]), n_subcategories = n_distinct(subcategory), .by = category) |> complete(category, fill = list(n_features = 0L, n_ko = 0L, n_pfam = 0L, n_subcategories = 0L)) |> arrange(category) panel_summary ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} message(glue("{nrow(panel_features)} panel features ", "({sum(panel_features$match_type == 'pfam')} matched by Pfam) | ", "{n_distinct(panel_long$subcategory)} subcategories")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 320 panel features (12 matched by Pfam) | 46 subcategories ``` ::: ::: > For results: features per trophic mode (`06_panel_summary.csv`). A mode with few features is reported gene by gene, not as a category. # Detection: one call for every panel feature The paired table holds one row per transcript × KO (multi-KO transcripts split their TPM equally, `R/prep_paired.R`). Panel rows are pulled from it twice and stacked: rows whose KO is a panel KO, and rows whose Pfam string matches a Pfam-only panel gene. Summing a Pfam gene's rows over a transcript's KO splits gives back its full TPM. A transcript that matches both a panel KO and a Pfam gene counts toward both features. Transcripts with no KO are not in the paired table, so Pfam genes are scored only on their KO-carrying transcripts. `scripts/QC_pfam_panel_check.R` reports how much expression that leaves out (most of phoX and microbial rhodopsin, `qc-pfam-panel-summary.csv`). >SKH: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} paired <- load_paired(fields = FIELDS_IN_SCOPE, depth = CHOSEN_DEPTH) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` [load_paired] data/processed/paired_L4.RData (built 2026-11-08 11:40; 324,868 rows) ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} units <- paired |> distinct(unit = sample_unit, vent_bin, field) |> mutate(habitat = if_else(vent_bin == "Vent", "vent", "nonvent")) n_units <- units |> count(habitat) |> deframe() # nonvent, vent min_units <- MIN_UNITS[names(n_units)] # 05 rule: 3 of 13 vent, 3 of 6 non-vent old_units <- ceiling(OCC_MIN * n_units - 1e-9) # old 30% rule (4 of 13, 2 of 6), sensitivity only stopifnot(!anyNA(min_units)) message(glue("{n_units[['vent']]} vent and {n_units[['nonvent']]} non-vent units | ", "present = >= {min_units[['vent']]} vent or >= {min_units[['nonvent']]} non-vent units")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 13 vent and 6 non-vent units | present = >= 3 vent or >= 3 non-vent units ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # unit totals from the FULL table, so panel rows share the 05 denominator unit_totals <- paired |> mutate(unit = sample_unit) |> summarise(unit_total = sum(scaledTPM) / first(n_reps), .by = c(unit, vent_bin, field)) # all KOs detected per unit: the depth context for B ko_detected_per_unit <- unit_expression(paired, "ko_id", MIN_TPM, MIN_PER_MILLION, totals = unit_totals) |> summarise(n_ko_detected = sum(detected), .by = unit) # Pfam-only genes: a PFAMs string maps to a gene when all its domains belong to it pfam_genes <- panel_ref |> filter(match_type == "pfam") |> distinct(feature_id, pfam_name) |> mutate(domains = str_split(pfam_name, ";")) pfam_key <- tibble(PFAMs = character(), feature_id = character()) if (nrow(pfam_genes)) { pfam_key <- paired |> distinct(PFAMs) |> filter(!is.na(PFAMs), !PFAMs %in% c("", "-")) |> mutate(feature_id = map_chr(PFAMs, \(p) { d <- str_split_1(p, ",") hit <- pfam_genes$feature_id[map_lgl(pfam_genes$domains, \(f) all(d %in% f))] if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_ })) |> filter(!is.na(feature_id)) } pfam_key |> count(feature_id, name = "n_pfam_strings") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} keep_cols <- c("sample_unit", "n_reps", "scaledTPM", "cur_group", "cur_L4") panel_kos <- panel_features$feature_id[panel_features$match_type == "ko"] panel_rows <- bind_rows( paired |> filter(ko_id %in% panel_kos) |> select(all_of(keep_cols), feature_id = ko_id), paired |> inner_join(pfam_key, by = "PFAMs") |> select(all_of(keep_cols), feature_id) ) taxon_info <- panel_rows |> distinct(cur_L4, cur_group) stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(taxon_info$cur_L4)) # feature x unit, and taxon x feature x unit ue_feature <- unit_expression(panel_rows, "feature_id", MIN_TPM, MIN_PER_MILLION, totals = unit_totals) ue_pair <- unit_expression(panel_rows, c("cur_L4", "feature_id"), MIN_TPM, MIN_PER_MILLION, totals = unit_totals) message(glue("{n_distinct(ue_feature$feature_id)} of {nrow(panel_features)} panel features ", "have expression in >= 1 unit; {n_distinct(ue_feature$feature_id[ue_feature$detected])} ", "are detected in >= 1 unit")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 283 of 320 panel features have expression in >= 1 unit; 273 are detected in >= 1 unit ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # >SKH: every curated L4 taxon in the paired table, for the full matrix in D (2026-11-08) all_taxa <- paired |> distinct(cur_L4, cur_group) stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(all_taxa$cur_L4)) rm(paired, panel_rows); invisible(gc()) ``` ::: # B. Feature × sample unit Every panel feature with expression anywhere, across all 19 units (zero-filled). Units are ordered by habitat and field. Detected-feature counts per unit are shown against the number of KOs detected in that unit, because a deeper unit clears detection for more features of every kind: a unit with few panel detections is first a unit with few detections overall. >SKH: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} unit_levels <- units |> arrange(desc(habitat), field, unit) |> pull(unit) unit_detection <- complete_units(ue_feature, select(units, unit, vent_bin, field), "feature_id") |> left_join(select(units, unit, habitat), by = "unit") |> mutate(per_million = share * 1e6) |> left_join(select(panel_features, feature_id, match_type, category, subcategory, gene), by = "feature_id") |> select(feature_id, match_type, category, subcategory, gene, unit, habitat, vent_bin, field, tpm, per_million, detected) # per unit and mode: panel features detected, against all KOs detected unit_summary <- unit_detection |> filter(detected) |> distinct(unit, feature_id) |> inner_join(distinct(panel_long, feature_id, category), by = "feature_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |> count(unit, category, name = "n_panel_detected", .drop = FALSE) |> complete(unit = units$unit, category, fill = list(n_panel_detected = 0L)) |> left_join(units, by = "unit") |> left_join(ko_detected_per_unit, by = "unit") |> mutate(frac_of_detected_kos = n_panel_detected / n_ko_detected) unit_summary |> summarise(median_panel = median(n_panel_detected), median_frac = median(frac_of_detected_kos), .by = c(category, habitat)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ud_df <- unit_detection |> select(-category, -subcategory) |> inner_join(distinct(panel_plot, feature_id, category, subcategory), by = "feature_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |> left_join(select(panel_features, feature_id, feature_lab, shared), by = "feature_id") |> mutate(feature_lab = if_else(shared, paste0(feature_lab, "\u2020"), as.character(feature_lab))) |> mutate(unit = factor(unit, levels = unit_levels), habitat = factor(habitat, levels = c("vent", "nonvent"), labels = c("Vent", "Non-vent")), mode = str_wrap(as.character(category), 14), subcategory = str_wrap(subcategory, 18), call = if_else(detected, as.character(habitat), "Not detected")) fig_unit_detection <- ggplot(ud_df, aes(unit, feature_lab, fill = call)) + geom_tile(color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.3) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(Vent = presence_pal[["vent_only"]], `Non-vent` = presence_pal[["nonvent_only"]], `Not detected` = "white"), name = NULL) + facet_grid(mode + subcategory ~ habitat + field, scales = "free", space = "free") + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = "\u2020 also in another trophic mode") + theme_minimal(base_size = 7) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, color = "black"), strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, color = "black")) fig_unit_detection # ggsave("figures/06-panel-unit-detection.svg", fig_unit_detection, width = 6, height = 24) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](06-trophic-mode-panel_files/figure-html/fig-unit-detection-1.png){#fig-unit-detection width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} fig_unit_depth <- unit_summary |> filter(category %in% panel_summary$category[panel_summary$n_features > 0]) |> ggplot(aes(n_ko_detected, n_panel_detected, colour = habitat, shape = habitat)) + geom_point(size = 2) + scale_colour_manual(values = c(vent = presence_pal[["vent_only"]], nonvent = presence_pal[["nonvent_only"]]), labels = c(vent = "Vent", nonvent = "Non-vent"), name = NULL) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(vent = 17, nonvent = 16), # vent triangle, non-vent circle labels = c(vent = "Vent", nonvent = "Non-vent"), name = NULL) + facet_wrap(~ category, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) + labs(x = "KOs detected in the unit", y = "Panel features detected") + theme_bw(base_size = 9) fig_unit_depth # ggsave("figures/06-panel-unit-depth.svg", fig_unit_depth, width = 9, height = 4) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](06-trophic-mode-panel_files/figure-html/fig-unit-depth-1.png){#fig-unit-depth width=864} ::: ::: > For results: panel features detected per unit against all KOs detected per unit (`06_panel_unit_summary.csv`). If panel counts follow the KO count, the unit pattern is depth, not a trophic shift. # C. Feature × habitat The same occupancy rule as 05 (`habitat_occupancy()`): associated with a habitat when detected in ≥ 3 of its units (3 of 13 vent, 3 of 6 non-vent); vent-only = never detected in background water, plume detections allowed (2026-11-23). Sections D-F use the same unit counts for presence. `below_filter` features are detected somewhere but clear the rule in neither habitat; `not_detected` features are never detected. For KO features the class must match `05_ko_habitat_class.csv` once 05 has been re-rendered on the same paired table; a mismatch raises a warning. >SKH: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} panel_occ <- habitat_occupancy(ue_feature, select(units, unit, vent_bin, field), "feature_id", MIN_UNITS, VENTONLY_TOLERATED) panel_habitat <- panel_features |> left_join(panel_occ |> transmute(feature_id, n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent, occ_vent, occ_nonvent, habitat_class = as.character(habitat_class)), by = "feature_id") |> mutate(habitat_class = factor(replace_na(habitat_class, "not_detected"), levels = class_levels), across(c(n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent), \(x) replace_na(x, 0L)), across(c(occ_vent, occ_nonvent), \(x) replace_na(x, 0))) # KO features against 05 (same rule, same table) agreement_05 <- panel_habitat |> filter(match_type == "ko") |> inner_join(read_csv(HABITAT_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |> select(feature_id = ko_id, habitat_class_05 = habitat_class), by = "feature_id") |> summarise(n_compared = n(), n_agree = sum(as.character(habitat_class) == habitat_class_05)) agreement_05 ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} if (agreement_05$n_agree < agreement_05$n_compared) { warning(agreement_05$n_compared - agreement_05$n_agree, " panel KO(s) differ from ", HABITAT_TABLE, ". Re-render 05 on the current paired table.", call. = FALSE) } # per mode; a feature in two modes counts once, under heterotrophy/phagotrophy (dagger) panel_habitat_mode <- panel_plot |> distinct(feature_id, category) |> left_join(select(panel_habitat, feature_id, habitat_class), by = "feature_id") |> count(category, habitat_class, .drop = FALSE) panel_habitat_subcat <- panel_plot |> left_join(select(panel_habitat, feature_id, habitat_class), by = "feature_id") |> count(category, subcategory, habitat_class, .drop = FALSE) |> filter(paste(category, subcategory) %in% paste(panel_plot$category, panel_plot$subcategory)) |> pivot_wider(names_from = habitat_class, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) panel_habitat_mode |> pivot_wider(names_from = habitat_class, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} panel_habitat_subcat ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} fig_panel_habitat <- panel_habitat_mode |> ggplot(aes(n, fct_rev(category), fill = habitat_class)) + geom_col(colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.2) + scale_fill_manual(values = class_pal, name = "Habitat class", drop = FALSE) + labs(x = "Panel features", y = NULL) + theme_bw(base_size = 9) fig_panel_habitat # ggsave("figures/06-panel-habitat.svg", fig_panel_habitat, width = 8, height = 4) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](06-trophic-mode-panel_files/figure-html/fig-panel-habitat-1.png){#fig-panel-habitat width=768} ::: ::: > For results: features per trophic mode in each habitat class (`06_panel_habitat_mode.csv`), > and which subcategories hold the vent-associated ones (`06_panel_habitat_subcategory.csv`). # D. Taxon × feature × habitat A taxon carries a panel feature in a habitat when the taxon × feature pair is detected in ≥ 3 of that habitat's units (3 of 13 vent, 3 of 6 non-vent; 05 rule). Each pair is labelled vent only, non-vent only, or both. The same call is applied to **all** taxon × KO pairs (`05b_taxon_ko_pairs.csv.gz`) as a background, because the vent/non-vent split of pairs is not specific to the panel: compare the panel split with the background before reading it as a trophic result. >SKH: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # pairs detected in >= 1 unit, with per-habitat unit counts pair_counts <- ue_pair |> summarise(n_det_vent = sum(detected & vent_bin == "Vent"), n_det_nonvent = sum(detected & vent_bin != "Vent"), .by = c(cur_L4, feature_id)) |> filter(n_det_vent + n_det_nonvent > 0) # vent_min / nonvent_min: units needed in each habitat presence_call <- function(df, vent_min, nonvent_min) { df |> mutate(in_vent = n_det_vent >= vent_min, in_nonvent = n_det_nonvent >= nonvent_min) |> filter(in_vent | in_nonvent) |> mutate(presence = factor(case_when(in_vent & in_nonvent ~ "both", in_vent ~ "vent_only", TRUE ~ "nonvent_only"), levels = names(presence_lab))) |> select(-in_vent, -in_nonvent) } taxon_presence <- pair_counts |> presence_call(min_units[["vent"]], min_units[["nonvent"]]) |> left_join(taxon_info, by = "cur_L4") |> mutate(taxon = taxon_label_unique(cur_L4)) |> inner_join(panel_long, by = "feature_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |> select(cur_group, cur_L4, taxon, category, subcategory, feature_id, match_type, gene, n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent, presence) # one row per taxon x feature (subcategory and mode duplicates removed) taxon_pairs <- taxon_presence |> distinct(cur_group, cur_L4, taxon, feature_id, presence) message(glue("{n_distinct(taxon_pairs$feature_id)} of {nrow(panel_features)} panel features carried by ", "{n_distinct(taxon_pairs$cur_L4)} taxa in {nrow(taxon_pairs)} taxon x feature pairs")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 176 of 320 panel features carried by 101 taxa in 882 taxon x feature pairs ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # sensitivity to the rule, panel and background side by side rules <- tibble(rule = c("05 rule (>= 3 units)", "old 30% of units (4 / 2)", paste0(">= ", SENS_MIN_UNITS, " unit(s)")), vent_min = c(min_units[["vent"]], old_units[["vent"]], SENS_MIN_UNITS), nonvent_min = c(min_units[["nonvent"]], old_units[["nonvent"]], SENS_MIN_UNITS)) background_pairs <- read_csv(PAIR_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |> select(cur_L4, feature_id = ko_id, n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent) presence_sensitivity <- pmap_dfr(rules, \(rule, vent_min, nonvent_min) { bind_rows(panel = presence_call(pair_counts, vent_min, nonvent_min) |> count(presence), background = presence_call(background_pairs, vent_min, nonvent_min) |> count(presence), .id = "pairs") |> mutate(frac = round(n / sum(n), 3), .by = pairs) |> mutate(rule = rule, .before = 1) }) presence_sensitivity ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # per taxon and mode: features carried in each habitat state taxon_mode_summary <- taxon_presence |> distinct(cur_group, taxon, category, feature_id, presence) |> count(cur_group, taxon, category, presence) |> pivot_wider(names_from = presence, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |> mutate(n_features = rowSums(across(any_of(names(presence_lab))))) |> arrange(category, desc(n_features)) taxon_mode_summary |> slice_max(n_features, n = 10, by = category) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: > For results: the vent only / non-vent only / both split of panel pairs next to the > background split (`06_panel_presence_sensitivity.csv`), and the taxa carrying the most > features per mode (`06_panel_taxon_mode_summary.csv`). ## Every panel gene × every L4 taxon >SKH: added 2026-11-08. Every panel feature, in all four modes, is scored against every class-level (curated L4) taxon in the paired table, including the pairs never detected, so absence is explicit rather than implied by a missing row. Each taxon × feature pair gets one state per panel: *present* (detected in ≥ 3 vent or ≥ 3 non-vent units, the 05 rule; ≥ 6 of 19 for all samples), *below threshold* (detected in ≥ 1 unit but below that bar), or *absent* (no unit). The panels are vent (13 units), non-vent (6 units), and all samples (19 units, ≥ 6 for present), so the all-samples panel shows how widespread a pattern is across the whole dataset. Descriptive, not tested. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} n_all <- sum(n_units) min_all <- ceiling(OCC_MIN * n_all - 1e-9) # 30% of 19 -> 6 pa_states <- c(present = "Present (>= 3 units; all samples >= 6 of 19)", below_threshold = "Detected, below threshold", absent = "Not detected") pa_state <- function(n, min_n) { factor(case_when(n >= min_n ~ "present", n > 0 ~ "below_threshold", TRUE ~ "absent"), levels = names(pa_states)) } taxon_pa_matrix <- all_taxa |> mutate(taxon = taxon_label_unique(cur_L4)) |> cross_join(select(panel_features, feature_id, match_type, category, subcategory, gene)) |> left_join(select(pair_counts, cur_L4, feature_id, n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent), by = c("cur_L4", "feature_id")) |> mutate(across(c(n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent), \(x) as.integer(coalesce(x, 0L))), n_det_all = n_det_vent + n_det_nonvent, frac_all = round(n_det_all / n_all, 3), vent = pa_state(n_det_vent, min_units[["vent"]]), nonvent = pa_state(n_det_nonvent, min_units[["nonvent"]]), all_samples = pa_state(n_det_all, min_all)) |> arrange(cur_group, taxon, feature_id) # per feature: how many L4 taxa carry it in each panel (breadth across lineages) feature_taxon_breadth <- taxon_pa_matrix |> summarise(n_taxa_vent = sum(vent == "present"), n_taxa_nonvent = sum(nonvent == "present"), n_taxa_all = sum(all_samples == "present"), n_taxa_any_det = sum(n_det_all > 0), n_groups_all = n_distinct(cur_group[all_samples == "present"]), .by = c(feature_id, match_type, category, subcategory, gene)) |> arrange(category, desc(n_taxa_all)) message(glue("{nrow(all_taxa)} L4 taxa x {nrow(panel_features)} panel features = ", "{nrow(taxon_pa_matrix)} pairs | present: {sum(taxon_pa_matrix$vent == 'present')} vent, ", "{sum(taxon_pa_matrix$nonvent == 'present')} non-vent, ", "{sum(taxon_pa_matrix$all_samples == 'present')} all samples (>= {min_all} of {n_all})")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 263 L4 taxa x 320 panel features = 84160 pairs | present: 266 vent, 836 non-vent, 347 all samples (>= 6 of 19) ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} feature_taxon_breadth |> slice_max(n_taxa_all, n = 5, by = category, with_ties = FALSE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}

Lineage contrasts ## Lineage groups Fixed before looking at the data, from the literature; edit `lineage_groups` to change membership. Each contrast compares lineages with a documented lifestyle (`focal`) against free-living relatives in the same phylum (`reference`). Lineages not listed (e.g. "(unres.)" bins, *Mesodinium*) stay out of both sides. * **Ciliates.** Armophorea, Muranotrichea and Parablepharismea form a clade of obligate anaerobes that all host prokaryotic symbionts (Rotterová et al. 2020, *Curr Biol* 30:2037–2050); Plagiopylea are anaerobic ciliates with prokaryotic symbionts (Fenchel et al. 1977, *J Protozool* 24:154–163), including a denitrifying endosymbiont (Graf et al. 2021, *Nature* 591:445–450). * **Syndiniales.** Parasitoids of other protists (John et al. 2019, *Sci Adv* 5:eaav1110; Farhat et al. 2018, *Front Microbiol* 9:2251), against free-living dinoflagellate lineages. Dinophyceae includes mixotrophs and a few parasites, so the reference is not purely free-living. * **Myzozoa.** Apicomplexans, gregarines, squirmids and perkinsids (parasites) against chromerids and colpodellids (free-living photosynthetic or predatory relatives; Woo et al. 2015, *eLife* 4:e06974; Mathur et al. 2019, *Curr Biol* 29:2936–2941; Leander et al. 2003, *J Eukaryot Microbiol* 50:334–340; Hoppenrath and Leander 2009, *J Eukaryot Microbiol* 56:251–256). The QC chunk checks that no `cur_L4` sits on both sides of a contrast. "Dinophyceae" can appear on both sides by name only, as two curated lineages (one under Syndiniales, one under Dinophyta). ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ciliate_reference <- c("Colpodea", "Heterotrichea", "Litostomatea", "Nassophorea", "Oligohymenophorea", "Phyllopharyngea", "Prostomatea", "Spirotrichea") myzozoa_parasite <- c("Aconoidasia", "Apicomplexa (unres.)", "Ancora", "Cardiosporidium", "Cephaloidophora", "Digyalum", "Eleutheroschizon", "Filipodium", "Hammondia", "Lankesteria", "Platyproteum", "Polyplicarium", "Rhytidocystis", "Selenidium", "Siedleckia", "Squirmida (unres.)", "Perkinsea (unres.)", "Perkinsida") myzozoa_freeliving <- c("Alphamonadaceae", "Chromeraceae", "Chromerida_X", "Colpodellaceae", "Colpodellida (unres.)", "Colponema", "Colponemidia (unres.)", "Vitrellaceae") lineage_groups <- bind_rows( tibble(contrast = "Ciliates: anaerobic, symbiont-bearing vs. other classes", phylum = "Alveolata-Ciliophora", role = "focal", lineage = c("Armophorea", "Muranotrichea", "Parablepharismea", "Plagiopylea")), tibble(contrast = "Ciliates: anaerobic, symbiont-bearing vs. other classes", phylum = "Alveolata-Ciliophora", role = "reference", lineage = ciliate_reference), # Syndiniales: every lineage of the curated Syndiniales phylum, plus Amoebophryaceae # wherever the curation placed it pairs |> filter(phylum == "Alveolata-Syndiniales") |> distinct(phylum, lineage) |> mutate(contrast = "Syndiniales vs. free-living dinoflagellates", role = "focal"), tibble(contrast = "Syndiniales vs. free-living dinoflagellates", phylum = "Alveolata-Dinophyta", role = "focal", lineage = "Amoebophryaceae"), tibble(contrast = "Syndiniales vs. free-living dinoflagellates", phylum = "Alveolata-Dinophyta", role = "reference", lineage = c("Dinophyceae", "Noctilucales", "Oxyrrhinales")), tibble(contrast = "Myzozoa: parasites vs. free-living relatives", phylum = "Alveolata-Myzozoa", role = "focal", lineage = myzozoa_parasite), tibble(contrast = "Myzozoa: parasites vs. free-living relatives", phylum = "Alveolata-Myzozoa", role = "reference", lineage = myzozoa_freeliving)) stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(lineage_groups[c("contrast", "phylum", "lineage")])) grouped_pairs <- pairs |> inner_join(lineage_groups, by = c("phylum", "lineage"), relationship = "many-to-many") #
